items.html: But nevertheless, he is not fit to procreate except by way of chance; but the main procreation is after the entry of the Hassadim themselves, which are in the NH and the two lower thirds of the Tifferet of ZA himself. It is found that the three Hassadim less a third, which are revealed as mentioned, each one is now in its place. And then, immediately after nine years and one day, all of them descend into the Yesod of ZA, for the two and a third upper ones are closed within the Yesod of Tevunah, as mentioned.
